# Independent exact-F2 certificate: the anti-Fano 12-line configuration has minimum cost 12 (no kappa claim)

Contributor: **Aaron Wang**, with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance; no independent human review claimed).

## Summary

Package `research/antifano-tied-min-cost12-seed22ae1f95/`. This is item 1 of the
[independent-check request](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18934590)
(DreamingOfClouds): a certificate from a different method that the anti-Fano 12-line
configuration `tied_min` has minimum admissible pairing cost exactly 12.

The certificate is a third method structurally: pure standard-library bitmask linear
algebra over F2, with explicit forced-zero triangular minor witnesses and complete
branch-and-bound enumerations. It uses no SAT, no CP-SAT, no exchange argument, no
characteristic-2 jet, and imports nothing from the predecessor packages. The model
encoding is re-derived from the pinned data alone (cross-read against
`research/three-total-decoders/lib/kit.py` at the
[PR 2111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111) head; no code imported).

Precise statement: over all admissible pairings `B` (0/1 over F2, unit diagonal, ones
only where `p(t)·q(s) = 0`), the minimum of `cost(B) = sum_j rank_F2 B[R_j, A_j]` is
exactly 12: every admissible `B` costs at least 12, and one attains 12. This is a
minimum, not equality for every `B` (the identity pairing costs 24). Coverage is exactly
this pinned configuration at `T = 3`. No statement about conjecture (A), any other
configuration, or any multiplication exponent.

## Method and completeness

Lower bound by case split that covers every falsifier (`2^72` admissible pairings):

1. Each block rank is at least 3 for every admissible `B`, via explicit triples with a
   forced-zero off-diagonal pattern making the principal 3x3 minor unit upper triangular
   in the listed order (witnesses: block 0 `[1,2,4]`, block 1 `[0,1,4]`, block 2 `[0,2,7]`).
2. A falsifier with `cost(B) <= 11` needs a block of rank exactly 3. For each block, the
   complete set of fillings of its 8 columns with F2 rank at most 3 is enumerated by
   branch and bound on the column spans: exactly one filling per block (counts 1, 1, 1).
3. For each such filling, all `2^24` completions of the four remaining class columns
   (six free entries each) are enumerated with exact ranks: the minimum of the other two
   block ranks sums to exactly 10 in every case (minima 10, 10, 10), so any `B` with a
   rank-3 block costs at least 13.

Upper bound: an explicit class-block-diagonal `B*` has block ranks `(4,4,4)` and cost 12;
the search finds exactly 6 rank-2 same-class fillings per class, consistent with the
predecessor's 216 = 6^3 class-block-diagonal optima.

Exact outputs are recorded in `cert_results.json`: 72 admissible off-diagonal entries,
6 free entries per column, unique rank-3 filling per block, residual minima 10/10/10 over
16,777,216 completions per block, `B*` ranks `(4,4,4)`, identity pairing cost 24.

Controls (all pass): positive controls `B = I` computes cost 24 and `B*` computes cost 12;
semantic failure controls — a tampered data pin is rejected by the SHA-256 check,
weakening one forced-zero entry breaks the triangular witness certificate, and removing
one used free entry of the unique rank-3 filling makes the enumeration return zero fillings.

## Overlap and added value

Predecessors: [PR 2111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111)
(DreamingOfClouds; Theorem T, exchange argument with one CNF step, plus CNF/CP-SAT
confirmations) and [PR 2162](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2162)
(DreamingOfClouds; Theorem T-prime, first-order char-2 jet). The model, the F2S rowspace
identity and the Massey-style floor framework are theirs and are credited here.

Concurrent overlap, found by the pre-submission overlap refresh (the entry survey missed
it because it is posted as a threaded reply,
[comment 18935962](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18935962)):
open [PR 2193](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2193) by petalas
(`research/antifano-subspace-audit`) also answers request item 1. It replaces the SAT
uniqueness step with complete column/row-basis subspace censuses — one rank-three
completion per block, agreeing with the counts 1, 1, 1 computed independently here — and
then applies the credited exchange argument for the final lower bound. What this package
adds is exactly what that audit leaves credited: the exchange step itself is discharged
here by complete residual enumeration (exact minimum other-block rank sum 10 = 5 + 5 over
all `2^24` completions per rank-three filling), plus exact residual bookkeeping and
distinct semantic failure controls. The two packages agree on the headline value 12.

Distinguished from the SPL(B) split min-max claim of
[comment 18941432](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18941432)
and the MAS-edge Theorem B2 (iii) work of
[PR 2340](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2340): different objects.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 research/antifano-tied-min-cost12-seed22ae1f95/check_certificate.py
```

About two minutes, standard library only, `PYTHONUTF8=1`; identical output
(`SUMMARY pass=18 fail=0`) on CPython 3.13.11 and CPython 3.12.14. The registered replay
is `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/antifano-tied-min-cost12-seed22ae1f95`
(`PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`, run locally). This host has no
`make`, so no make-based target is used or claimed.

Source pin: `data/tied_min.json` is a byte-exact copy (SHA-256
`670ed90924b601ade22f0d4adaff46d1667e5449326a0f7ba7b88dd8f5906f93`) of
`research/three-total-decoders/data/tied_min.json` at
[PR 2111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111) head
`98da76c2839ba38538b510420dec54546ccabf0b`, verified at run time. The file is not present
at the pinned base commit, so it is recorded in `SOURCES.json` under
`external_package_sources` rather than in the base-blob pin list.

## Scope note (changed from the drawn card)

Drawn track `independent-verification`, card `independent-moment`, chooser nonce
`22ae1f95059920d6c05b604d656ad644`. The card's natural object (an independent
moment/enclosure check of the MAS edge form of Theorem B2 (iii)) is occupied by fresh
parallel work ([comment 18941591](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18941591)
and [PR 2340](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2340)); the second card
`formal-interface-lemma` is saturated and its live Lean object cannot be built on this
host (no Lean toolchain installed). Taking the explicit open request instead is a
sanctioned scope change (autoresearch.md section 3); `TASK.json` records it with the
reason and keeps the card's acceptance gate (independence, source binding, positive cases,
semantic failure controls, named existing checks and missing coverage).

## Not checked / not claimed

No kappa claim, no selected-frontier change, no statement about any configuration other
than `tied_min`, no proof-assistant formalization, no replay of the predecessor packages,
and no claim about the predecessor CNF/CP-SAT results beyond agreeing with their stated
values. The claim is a finite universal statement over `2^72` admissible pairings
discharged exactly by the case split and enumerations above. Machine certificate, not a
human-written proof; the open question of extracting a forced-zero cascade proof of the
rank-3 uniqueness is recorded in the package.
